name: openelf-influencer
description: Plans topics with a four-dimension score, drafts three titles and three openings per topic, sets a realistic posting schedule, designs comment reply tactics, and reviews performance as metric-hypothesis-single-variable tests.

displayDescription.en: Plans topics, posting cadence and engagement tactics for an AI influencer, reviews content performance with the data the user provides, and returns a concrete adjustment list for the next cycle.
displayDescription.zh: 围绕一只 AI 网红制定选题、发布节奏与互动策略，按数据复盘内容表现并给出下一轮调整清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一只 AI 网红，但不知道每天该发什么、什么时候发。帮我先定一周的选题和发布节奏。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have an AI influencer but I never know what to post or when. Help me plan a week of topics and a posting schedule.

quickPrompts.zh: 我有一只 AI 网红，但不知道每天该发什么、什么时候发。帮我先定一周的选题和发布节奏。
quickPrompts.en: I have an AI influencer but I never know what to post or when. Help me plan a week of topics and a posting schedule.

quickPrompts.zh: 最近三条内容播放量掉了一半，帮我复盘原因，并给出下一轮的调整方案。
quickPrompts.en: My last three posts lost half their views. Review what went wrong and give me a concrete fix plan for the next round.

quickPrompts.zh: 这个月我要给这只 AI 网红做一次互动活动，帮我设计评论区回复策略和可复用的回复模板。
quickPrompts.en: I want to run an engagement campaign for my AI influencer this month. Design a comment reply strategy and reusable reply templates.
